title: Human Breast Tissues Dissociation
author: Quy Nguyen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.twbepan

steps.title: Prepare required reagents
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions: (a) Collagenase solution – 100 mg/mL Collagenase Type I dissolved in DMEM/Ham's F12 medium; (b) DMEM/Ham's F12 with 10 % FBS and 1 % antibiotic; (c) DMEM/Ham's F12 with 5 % FBS and 1 % antibiotic; (d) DNase – 1 mg/mL DNase in PBS.

steps.title: Wash tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Transfer the harvested breast tissues to a 150 cm plate. Wash repeatedly with large volumes of PBS (volume adjusted to tissue amount) to remove blood and storage media; aspirate after each wash. Perform three total PBS washes. Set aside small tissue fragments for FFPE or OCT blocks.

steps.title: Chop tissue into small fragments
steps.instruction: Using two number‑10 scalpels, mince the tissue until epithelial pieces are approximately 2–3 mm in size. Remove excess adipose tissue if present to facilitate chopping and later digestion.

steps.title: Collagenase digestion
steps.instruction: Place about 20 mL of the chopped tissue into each 50 mL conical tube. Add 20 mL of DMEM/Ham's F12 containing 5 % FBS and 4 mg/mL Collagenase Type I. Incubate on a shaker set to 37 °C, 180–200 rpm, for 12–16 hours.

steps.title: Pellet and wash organoids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the digestion tubes at 400 g for 5 min. Aspirate the supernatant, then add 50 mL of PBS to wash. Centrifuge again at 400 g for 5 min and discard the PBS wash.

steps.title: Trypsin dissociation
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 0.05 % Trypsin to each organoid pellet and incubate at 37 °C for 6 min. Every 2 min, gently pipette up and down with a P1000 tip (total of three pipetting cycles). Add 10 mL of DMEM with 10 % FBS, then centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min. Aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: DNase treatment and resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of DMEM with 10 % FBS, add 100 µL of the 1 mg/mL DNase stock, and incubate for 5 min at room temperature. Add 10 mL of DMEM with 10 % FBS, centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and finally resuspend the cells in 10 mL of DMEM with 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Count cells and adjust concentration
steps.instruction: Count the suspended cells, centrifuge once more at 400 g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend to the appropriate concentration required for downstream FACS staining.

steps.title: Stain cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Prepare staining tubes. To each tube add the following antibodies at the manufacturers’ recommended concentrations: PE‑CD49f, APC‑EpCAM, and DAPI‑CD45/CD31. Incubate for 20 min at 4 °C. After staining, wash the cells with DMEM, pass the suspension through a FACS tube filter, and finally add Sytox Green just before sorting.

steps.title: Filter and sort live cells
steps.instruction: Run the stained cell suspension on the flow cytometer, gating for Sytox Green‑negative (live) cells and collecting the desired populations.
